articleTitle: Integral and integradifferential equations for photonic crystal
publicationTitle: International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering, 2004. APEDE 2004.
abstract: In resent years, in connection with big development of nanotechnology, there is a grate interest to one-dimensional (ID), two-dimensional (ZD), and three-dimensional (3D) artificial periodic structures, which usually obtained by implantation of different bodies (metallic, dielectric, semiconductive etc.) into the based homogeneous dielectric (see, for example, special issue [1]). Such structures in optics were named as photonic crystals (PCs). Often they have unique properties such as cyrality, anisotropy and bianisotropy [2-4], both negative permittivity and permiability in any frequency range [5-7] with corresponding effects [8], including the unusual refraction and reflection lows. Also they may have the bandgap [5-7]. Such structures well known for a long time and were named earlier as artificial dielectrics (AD) [9-11],but the most papers used the approximate or model approaches to analyze AD or PC. Moreover, the PCs usually are analyzed in the resonance or high frequency range where the rigorous electromagnetic modeling is necessary.

articleTitle: Scalar waves of the energy of packet-wave electromagnetic field in dissipation medium
publicationTitle: International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering, 2004. APEDE 2004.
abstract: Vector fields of plane-polarized fading waves decompose by local space-temporary projecting on field of fading elliptical-polarized waves. Orthogonality of used projection operator forbids the interaction between different-polarized (left-hand and right-hand) elliptical waves; local conservativity of the considered system, which appears after fixing spatial watchpoint, allows one to use Hamilton descriptions. As a result the possibility for the building kinematically strict expressions for the scalar waves of density electric and magnetic energy (as proper, so and interference) from all considered elliptical waves is appears. Expressions for the velocities of the proper and interference energy and for the velocity of the energy of whole wave package are found.

publicationTitle: International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering, 2004. APEDE 2004.
abstract: Implementation of the vector tetrahedral finite element method for high-frequency electromagnetic field simulation is described.
